rubrics.justification: Description is broadly consistent with a Day 5 full blastocyst and the provided 2AB grade, with appropriate comments on compact ICM and looser/sparser TE; minor issue is introducing some uncertainty (2AB/BB) and limited detail on zona pellucida.

Integrates age, endometrium, BMI, ovarian response, male factor, and lifestyle factors well with embryo quality; could more explicitly relate AMH/FSH and semen findings to expected embryo competence and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and mostly consistent, with conclusions generally supported by morphology and patient factors; slight weakness is some overinterpretation of male-factor implications and the mixed 2AB/BB phrasing.

Recommendations are largely consistent with standard IVF practice: proceed with single embryo transfer, avoid unnecessary add-ons, selective PGT-A discussion, and reassessment only after repeated failure; minor deviations include speculative emphasis on sperm DNA fragmentation without stronger indication.

Provides clear, practical next steps for current transfer and contingency planning for future cycles, including SET, lifestyle changes, follow-up if negative, and when to consider further male-factor workup or PGT-A.
